summary: Learn to assess Bitcoin and Ethereum transactions, wallet controls, and cryptoasset risks. Review the five-day foundation course and enrol.
lede: Blockchain and cryptocurrency training helps finance, technology risk, audit, and operations professionals assess digital-asset activity. It covers comparing public and permissioned networks, interpreting Bitcoin and Ethereum transaction records, and reviewing wallet, key-custody, and token-claim risks. Practical exercises include mapping transaction evidence, building a wallet-control checklist, and preparing an adoption decision brief using ISO 22739 terminology.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who assess, process, control, or explain blockchain and cryptocurrency activity as part of their regular work. It suits roles that need a working grasp of transaction evidence, wallet responsibilities, and digital-asset risks, without requiring programming experience.
modules: Bitcoin Ledger Records and Transaction Evidence
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No prior blockchain programming experience is expected. Basic familiarity with digital payments, transaction processing, or business controls will help you connect the examples to your work. Coding is not required; cryptography and smart-contract execution are introduced at a conceptual-awareness level.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
